categories.name: Rotary Compressors
categories.h1: Rotary Air Conditioner Compressors — Second-Hand Wholesale Supply
categories.lead: Single-phase rotary compressors for split AC, window units and portable air conditioners from 0.5 HP to 3 HP, R22 / R410A / R32 designs.
keywords: second hand AC rotary compressor supplier
intro: Rotary compressors are the workhorse of residential and light commercial air conditioning. They run quietly, cost less than scroll equivalents in small capacities, and are easier to service in the field.
We supply fixed-speed and inverter rotary compressors from 0.5 HP to 3 HP, covering R22, R410A and R32 refrigerants with 220–240 V / 50 Hz and 208–230 V / 60 Hz windings for different export markets.
buying_notes: Match refrigerant exactly — an R410A compressor cannot replace an R22 unit without system redesign.
We supply 220–240 V / 50 Hz and 208–230 V / 60 Hz windings — tell us your market and we will match.
Ask whether the unit ships with the accumulator, mounting studs and start accessories.
For tropical markets we can supply T3-rated units — let us know your ambient class.

categories.name: Scroll Compressors
categories.h1: Scroll Air Conditioner Compressors — Second-Hand Wholesale Supply
categories.lead: Three-phase and single-phase scroll compressors from 2 HP to 30 HP for split systems, packaged units, heat pumps, chillers and VRF modules.
keywords: second hand Copeland scroll compressor supplier
second hand HVAC scroll compressor export
intro: Scroll compressors deliver higher efficiency and lower sound levels than rotary or reciprocating designs in medium and large capacities, which is why they dominate commercial split systems, heat pumps and packaged rooftop units.
Our scroll range covers 2 HP to 30 HP in R410A, R407C and R32 versions, including replacement models that cross to major reference numbers used in the field.
buying_notes: We verify rotation direction and single vs three-phase supply against your requirement before dispatch.
Scroll compressors are sensitive to burnout acid — always replace the drier and check for acid after a motor failure.
Check compressor discharge line temperature limits when retrofitting to R32.
Ask us for the cross-reference table if you are replacing an existing unit.

categories.name: Hermetic Reciprocating Compressors
categories.h1: Hermetic Reciprocating Compressors — Second-Hand Wholesale Supply
categories.lead: RSIR / CSIR / RSCR reciprocating compressors for freezers, refrigerators, cold rooms, ice machines, display cases and beverage coolers.
keywords: second hand freezer compressor bulk buy
intro: Hermetic reciprocating compressors remain the standard for light commercial refrigeration. Compact, reliable and easy to match to cabinets, they cover everything from domestic freezers to cold rooms and ice machines.
We stock LBP (low back pressure), MBP (medium back pressure) and HBP (high back pressure) series in R134a and R600a versions, with cabinet-style models for beverages and display cases.
Every unit is packed for export with palletized cartons, and we can arrange third-party inspection before shipment.
buying_notes: We stock LBP, MBP and HBP classes — tell us your duty and we will match the right unit.
We confirm whether an external starting relay and capacitor are required and include them as needed.
For water-cooled or remote systems we verify the indoor electric arrangements against your original.
R600a units require certified export packing for flammable refrigerant — we handle it.
